data.gender_notes: Nonah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'νοεω' (noeo), meaning 'to think, to contemplate'. In Greek mythology, Noe was the name of the goddess of wisdom and the personification of the mind. Nonah is a feminine variant of the name, which can be interpreted as 'grace' or 'favor'. The name Nonah carries the meaning “Grace, Favor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nonah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nonah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
